hooks.name: enforce-direct-file-tools
hooks.description: Inject directive instructing agy to use direct read and write file tools instead of bash scripts

hooks.name: read-limiter-reset-turn
hooks.description: Reset per-file read counters at the start of each new prompt

hooks.name: read-limiter-check
hooks.description: Deny reading the same file more than 3 times per prompt

hooks.name: warn-bash-usage
hooks.description: Warn or restrict running bash scripts when direct file tools should be used

hooks.name: read-limiter-reset-on-edit
hooks.description: Reset a file's read counter after it is successfully edited
